stem:
Rehan reads a bar chart titled "Favourite sports in Class 8A, 2024 school survey of $40$ students." Cricket has the tallest bar.

Which claim correctly limits what the display allows him to conclude?

options.text: The bars report Class 8A survey choices in $2024$; they do not by themselves prove why cricket is most popular.
Treat the bars as nationwide sports facts for every class, with no use of the Class 8A $2024$ survey source.
Cricket causes more students to join Class 8A.
Insert cricket into a sorted list and read the median as the conclusion from the bars.

teacher.key_rationale: Scope is the stated Class 8A 2024 survey of 40 students; popularity ranks are shown, but causes are not. Ignoring source/scope, inventing causes, or swapping in median machinery miss the hinge.
